attributes.readMe:
# Project

## Summary
A project with `status` (planned | active | done), a `lead` (Employee), a `team`, an optional external `vendor`, a `startDate` and an `estimatedEffort` DurationField.

## Import
```ts
import { Project } from './project';
```

## Usage
Link projects to the tracker app to show them on the Dashboard tab.

## Template Usage
Embedded view shows status, start, effort, lead, and vendor; fitted is an icon row.
